metadata.question: Did the burn scar area within a 3km radius of 45.506013°N, 110.517217°W (the Pine Creek region near the Yellowstone River) increase between mid-August 2012 and mid-September, 2012?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Point at 45.506013°N, 110.517217°W with 3km radius buffer - Time periods: Mid-August 2012 (Aug 10-20) and Mid-September 2012 (Sep 10-20) - Collection: Landsat 7 for 2012 (Landsat 8 launched 2013), use NBR (Normalized Burn Ratio) to detect burn scars 2. Masking strategy: - Mask clouds using QA band - Calculate NBR (NIR - SWIR2) / (NIR + SWIR2) - Burn scars have low NBR values (typically < 0.1 or using threshold) - Compare burn scar area between the two periods 3. Logic to distinguish: - Valid Zero (B): Burn scar area decreased or stayed same (valid measurement) - Valid Increase (A): Burn scar area increased - C1: No images in one or both periods - C2: Images exist but no valid pixels after masking - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-110.517217, 45.506013]); const roi = point.buffer(3000); // 3km radius const aug2012Start = '2012-08-10'; const aug2012End = '2012-08-20'; const sep2012Start = '2012-09-10'; const sep2012End = '2012-09-20'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Landsat 7 function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(cloudMask); } function addNBR(image) { const nir = image.select('SR_B4'); const swir2 = image.select('SR_B7'); const nbr = nir.subtract(swir2).divide(nir.add(swir2)).rename('NBR'); return image.addBands(nbr); } let colAug = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(aug2012Start, aug2012End) .map(maskClouds) .map(addNBR); let colSep = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(sep2012Start, sep2012End) .map(maskClouds) .map(addNBR); const augSize = colAug.size().getInfo(); const sepSize = colSep.size().getInfo(); console.log(`August 2012 Images: ${augSize}`); console.log(`September 2012 Images: ${sepSize}`); if (augSize === 0 || sepSize === 0) { console.log("Missing data for one or both periods."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Create median composites const augImage = colAug.median().select('NBR'); const sepImage = colSep.median().select('NBR'); // 4. Check pixel counts const augCount = augImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NBR').getInfo(); const sepCount = sepImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NBR').getInfo(); console.log(`August valid pixels: ${augCount}`); console.log(`September valid pixels: ${sepCount}`); if (augCount === 0 || sepCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 5. Calculate burn scar area (NBR < 0.1 threshold) const burnThreshold = 0.1; const augBurnMask = augImage.lt(burnThreshold); const sepBurnMask = sepImage.lt(burnThreshold); const augBurnArea = augBurnMask.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NBR').getInfo(); const sepBurnArea = sepBurnMask.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NBR').getInfo(); console.log(`August burn scar area: ${(augBurnArea / 1e6).toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`September burn scar area: ${(sepBurnArea / 1e6).toFixed(2)} km²`); // 6. Validation & Final Answer if (augBurnArea === null || sepBurnArea === null || isNaN(augBurnArea) || isNaN(sepBurnArea)) { console.log("Calculation failed."); console.log("C3"); return; } const increase = sepBurnArea - augBurnArea; console.log(`Change in burn scar: ${(increase / 1e6).toFixed(2)} km²`); if (increase > 0) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
